summary: Widened stat value text sits high; centre it vertically
author: pm
body:
When a stat-table value box widens to fit a long value (HH-0094), its text is drawn with put_aligned_string (Align::TopCenter in a 15 px band), which sits about 2 px higher than the put_string path used by a box at its base size. The majestic dialog's widened points box shows 100 against the top bevel.

Measured: hh0094_widen.png (2026-11-25), zoomed: widened 100 sits top-heavy; the row boxes (put_string) are centred.

**Done when:** a widened box draws its text at the same y as an unwidened one, centred horizontally, checked in the client on the majestic dialog.

Source: user report 2026-11-25 on .claude/scratch/coordinator/dialogs/hh0094_widen.png; IDialogBox::draw_stat_value in dialog_box.cpp.

**Verified, 2026-11-25:** built (Game Debug), majestic dialog in the client: widened 100 sits level with the row values; review PASS.
